jobs.title: Sr. Vice President of Engineering, Silicon Photonics
jobs.description:
Description

Skorpios Technologies, Inc.
is an innovator in heterogeneous integration of silicon photonic technology and semiconductor development. As we rapidly expand, we are seeking a visionary Sr. Vice President of Engineering
to lead our technical organization. This executive leader will be responsible for the development of next-generation III-V and Silicon Photonics chip and module products, driving the engineering roadmap from concept through high-volume manufacturing.

Job Purpose

The Sr. VP of Engineering is a key executive role responsible for the strategic leadership of Skorpios’ Integration and Process Development Engineering teams. This individual will oversee the implementation of high-performance Si-Photonic Data Communications solutions, ensuring that technical execution aligns with the overall company strategy. You will serve as the primary technical architect of the product roadmap, working in close partnership with the CEO, CRO, and key customers to deliver highly differentiated, disruptive technology.

Executive Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Roadmap: Define and execute the technical vision for Silicon Photonics and III-V device integration. Align engineering priorities with company-wide strategic goals and market demands.
Executive Collaboration: Partner directly with the CEO to guide technology implementation; collaborate with the CRO to ensure the engineering pipeline supports customer targets and requirements.
Project & Process Management: Establish rigorous engineering processes to transition complex designs from R&D to manufacturing. Own the accountability for project timelines, resource allocation, and budget management.
Innovation Oversight: Direct the design and modeling of high-efficiency Lasers, EAM/MZM modulators, and high-speed photodetectors, ensuring all components are optimized for Skorpios’ unique heterogeneous integration platform.
Operational Excellence: Implement Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Reliability (DFR) standards across the engineering organization to ensure scalable, high-yield production.
Stakeholder Management: Act as the technical face of the company for potential customers and strategic partners, presenting complex technical solutions as compelling business value propositions.

Technical Oversight

Lead teams in the simulation of electrical, RF, and optical performance (Ansys Lumerical, Zemax, etc.).
Oversee the establishment of tolerance and process design rules to enable DRC for integrated circuits.
Guide the characterization of devices, data analysis, and the translation of DOE (Design of Experiments) results into product improvements.
Ensure deep integration between III-V active components and Silicon Photonics passive devices (WDM, polarization rotators, 90-degree hybrids).

Leadership Competencies

Accountability: A results-driven mindset with the ability to take full ownership of technical failures and successes.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills; ability to distill complex physics and engineering challenges into actionable strategies for the Board of Directors and customers.
Interpersonal Impact: Proven ability to mentor high-level individual contributors and foster a culture of innovation and hard work in a fast-paced environment.
Strategic Problem Solving: Ability to navigate the challenges of a dynamic environment, making data-driven decisions under pressure.

Requirements

Required Education and Experience

Education: Ph.D. or M.S. in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Material Science, or a related Photonics discipline.
Experience: 15+ years of experience in the semiconductor or photonics industry, with at least 5–7 years in a senior leadership/executive capacity.
Technical Mastery: Deep industrial expertise in III-V and Silicon Photonics device design, epitaxy constraints, and high-speed optical communications.
Proven Track Record: Demonstrated success in leading high-performance technical teams through the full product lifecycle, from initial concept to disruptive market entry.

Work Environment & Travel

Based in a high-energy, collaborative office/lab environment.
Travel: Up to 25% anticipated for customer visits, vendor management, and industry conferences.

Why Skorpios?

At Skorpios, you will be at the forefront of the silicon photonics revolution. We offer the chance to work on truly disruptive technology that is changing how the world connects. You will be part of a team where technical excellence is celebrated and where your contributions have a direct impact on the success of our next-generation product lines.

Position Overview: The Senior Director of Engineering is a critical leader, responsible for defining and executing the global engineering strategy across medical device manufacturing operations. This role will lead cross-functional engineering teams, drive technological innovation, enhance manufacturing capabilities, and elevate operational performance across all sites. The Senior Director will partner closely with executive leadership to align engineering initiatives with corporate goals, ensuring scalability, compliance, and competitive advantage.

What You Will Do

Provide strategic vision and executive leadership for global engineering and advanced manufacturing functions.

Architect and implement long-term engineering roadmaps aligned with business growth and innovation strategies.

Lead large-scale process optimization, automation, and cost-reduction initiatives across multiple manufacturing sites.

Champion the adoption of advanced technologies, smart manufacturing, and digital transformation.

Develop and standardize world-class manufacturing processes that drive quality, consistency, and efficiency.

Build and lead high-performing, multidisciplinary engineering teams focused on continuous improvement and innovation.

Collaborate with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations to ensure engineering excellence from concept to commercialization.

Influence capital investments and infrastructure decisions to support long-term manufacturing strategy.

Serve as a technical advisor to senior executives and contribute to strategic planning and organizational development.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Leads a multi-site team of engineers and technical professionals.

Responsible for departmental structure, hiring, performance management, succession planning, and leadership development.

Oversees the execution and prioritization of complex engineering projects and continuous improvement programs.

Provides coaching, mentorship, and professional development opportunities to emerging leaders within the engineering function.

Skills For Success

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a closely related technical field.

Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in advanced manufacturing or engineering leadership roles.

8+ years of experience in senior-level engineering management with multi-site or global oversight.

Medical Device Industry Experience Strongly Preferred.

Preferred Education And Experience:

Master’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration (MBA), or related field.

Certified Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent lean manufacturing certifications.

Experience integrating new technologies (e.g., automation, robotics, digital manufacturing).

>40% travel required. Person ideally should be seated near Plano, Texas. This role will be instrumental in driving Global engineering strategy, Manufacturing innovation and automation, Process optimization and operational excellence, Digital transformation initiatives & high-performing, multi-site engineering teams.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Data Platform
jobs.description:
Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role

At Hadrian, data is part of the factory's operating system. The scheduler deciding what runs next, models predicting cycle time and demand, systems interpreting engineering drawings, analytics tracking production, and operators understanding what is happening on the floor all depend on the same thing: a trustworthy path from the physical and software systems that generate data to the teams and products that use it.

The Data Platform team owns that path. We build the shared infrastructure for ingestion and CDC, event streaming, the warehouse and lakehouse, orchestration, data contracts, quality, lineage, and the foundational data models that sit underneath Analytics, Data Science, Operations Research, ML, and operational software. Today that includes Snowflake, Iceberg on S3, PeerDB, Redpanda/Kafka, Dagster, dbt, Kubernetes, and protobuf/gRPC. Some of our data begins in conventional software systems. Some begins on CNC machines, inspection equipment, PLCs, engineering files, and the factory floor.

As an Senior Engineering Manager, you will build and lead the team responsible for making this platform reliable, coherent, and useful as Hadrian scales to many factories. You will own the people, execution, operating quality, and direction of the team while staying technically close enough to challenge architecture, understand failure modes, and help engineers make good tradeoffs.

What You’ll Do

Build the team and platform that become Hadrian's data backbone. Lead the engineers responsible for the path from machines and operational systems to the trusted datasets, streams, and interfaces that scheduling, analytics, ML, software, and factory operations depend on.
Own the Data Platform roadmap and delivery. Turn ambiguous needs across Software, Infrastructure, Analytics, Data Science, Operations Research, ML, and Manufacturing into clear priorities, interfaces, owners, and commitments.
Raise the operational bar for the platform: reliability, data-quality SLAs, observability, incident response, backfills and recovery, cost, security, schema evolution, provenance, and clear ownership when something fails.
Partner with senior engineers and technical leads on architecture across CDC and streaming, Snowflake and Iceberg, orchestration, data contracts, schema governance, and the interfaces between the data platform and its consumers. You do not need to design every system yourself, but you need the depth to ask the hard questions and recognize when important semantics or failure modes are missing.
Turn repeated one-off work into paved roads. Build standards, contracts, tooling, documentation, and migration paths that let other engineering and data teams move faster without creating a collection of bespoke pipelines.
Hire and grow an exceptional team. Set a clear technical and performance bar, give direct feedback, develop engineers into broader technical leaders, delegate real ownership, and build a team whose capability grows faster than its headcount.

What We’re Looking For

A track record leading engineers responsible for production data infrastructure, distributed systems, developer platforms, infrastructure, or similarly critical technical systems. For Senior EM, you have led multiple substantial workstreams or teams and developed senior technical leaders.
Strong technical judgment in modern data and platform systems: event streaming and CDC, warehouses and lakehouses, orchestration, schema evolution, data modeling, distributed-system failure modes, and the tradeoffs behind reliable data delivery.
Experience building for environments with real constraints. You understand that the architecture changes when data comes from hardware, machines, devices, files, telemetry, regulated systems, edge environments, or other sources that do not behave like a clean application database.
A real platform mindset. You think in shared abstractions, contracts, ownership, operating guarantees, adoption, migration, deprecation, and paved roads — not just a set of infrastructure components owned by one team.
An operator's mindset. You know what your systems promise, how you know they are healthy, what happens when those promises fail, and how an incident becomes a permanent improvement rather than a recurring story.
Strong people leadership and high agency across organizational boundaries. Your engineers know what is expected of them, where they stand, and how they can grow; when a dependency is blocking the team, you go resolve it rather than simply reporting it upward.

What Will Set You Apart

5+ years of management experience in manufacturing, semiconductors, hardware, robotics, autonomy, industrial systems, test/measurement, or edge computing, especially where the data platform had to bridge software with physical systems. Backgrounds from companies such as NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Xilinx, Altera, Qualcomm, Applied Materials, Lam Research, Tesla, Anduril, Shield AI, or similar environments are especially relevant.
Experience with heterogeneous data beyond application tables: telemetry, events, files, device identity, timestamps and clock drift, units, provenance, schema drift, deletes, late or out-of-order data, partial records, retries, and backfills.
Experience taking a data or infrastructure platform from an early working system to a broadly adopted internal product used by many teams.
Experience operating in security-sensitive or regulated environments such as aerospace, defense, FedRAMP, CMMC, or other environments where data governance and access control are part of the architecture.
A track record of building strong hiring and onboarding systems and helping senior engineers become effective technical leads, Staff+ engineers, or future managers.

Compensation

For this role, the target salary range is $249,000 -
$299,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Benefits For Full-time Employees

Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees
401k
Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.
Flexible vacation policy
Equity

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Use of AI in hiring

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy.

The Company does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race inclusive of traits historically associated with race (including, but not limited to, hair texture and protective hairstyles, such as braids, locks and twists), color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, national origin (including, in California, possession of a drivers license), ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, height or weight, medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, exercise of reproductive rights, any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws, or any combination of the above characteristics. new_jobs.description:
Description

Skorpios Technologies, Inc.
is an innovator in heterogeneous integration of silicon photonic technology and semiconductor development. As we rapidly expand, we are seeking a visionary Sr. Vice President of Engineering
to lead our technical organization. This executive leader will be responsible for the development of next-generation III-V and Silicon Photonics chip and module products, driving the engineering roadmap from concept through high-volume manufacturing.

Job Purpose

The Sr. VP of Engineering is a key executive role responsible for the strategic leadership of Skorpios’ Integration and Process Development Engineering teams. This individual will oversee the implementation of high-performance Si-Photonic Data Communications solutions, ensuring that technical execution aligns with the overall company strategy. You will serve as the primary technical architect of the product roadmap, working in close partnership with the CEO, CRO, and key customers to deliver highly differentiated, disruptive technology.

Executive Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Roadmap: Define and execute the technical vision for Silicon Photonics and III-V device integration. Align engineering priorities with company-wide strategic goals and market demands.
Executive Collaboration: Partner directly with the CEO to guide technology implementation; collaborate with the CRO to ensure the engineering pipeline supports customer targets and requirements.
Project & Process Management: Establish rigorous engineering processes to transition complex designs from R&D to manufacturing. Own the accountability for project timelines, resource allocation, and budget management.
Innovation Oversight: Direct the design and modeling of high-efficiency Lasers, EAM/MZM modulators, and high-speed photodetectors, ensuring all components are optimized for Skorpios’ unique heterogeneous integration platform.
Operational Excellence: Implement Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Reliability (DFR) standards across the engineering organization to ensure scalable, high-yield production.
Stakeholder Management: Act as the technical face of the company for potential customers and strategic partners, presenting complex technical solutions as compelling business value propositions.

Technical Oversight

Lead teams in the simulation of electrical, RF, and optical performance (Ansys Lumerical, Zemax, etc.).
Oversee the establishment of tolerance and process design rules to enable DRC for integrated circuits.
Guide the characterization of devices, data analysis, and the translation of DOE (Design of Experiments) results into product improvements.
Ensure deep integration between III-V active components and Silicon Photonics passive devices (WDM, polarization rotators, 90-degree hybrids).

Leadership Competencies

Accountability: A results-driven mindset with the ability to take full ownership of technical failures and successes.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills; ability to distill complex physics and engineering challenges into actionable strategies for the Board of Directors and customers.
Interpersonal Impact: Proven ability to mentor high-level individual contributors and foster a culture of innovation and hard work in a fast-paced environment.
Strategic Problem Solving: Ability to navigate the challenges of a dynamic environment, making data-driven decisions under pressure.

Requirements

Required Education and Experience

Education: Ph.D. or M.S. in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Material Science, or a related Photonics discipline.
Experience: 15+ years of experience in the semiconductor or photonics industry, with at least 5–7 years in a senior leadership/executive capacity.
Technical Mastery: Deep industrial expertise in III-V and Silicon Photonics device design, epitaxy constraints, and high-speed optical communications.
Proven Track Record: Demonstrated success in leading high-performance technical teams through the full product lifecycle, from initial concept to disruptive market entry.

Work Environment & Travel

Based in a high-energy, collaborative office/lab environment.
Travel: Up to 25% anticipated for customer visits, vendor management, and industry conferences.

Why Skorpios?

At Skorpios, you will be at the forefront of the silicon photonics revolution. We offer the chance to work on truly disruptive technology that is changing how the world connects. You will be part of a team where technical excellence is celebrated and where your contributions have a direct impact on the success of our next-generation product lines.

new_jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Data Platform
new_jobs.description:
Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role

At Hadrian, data is part of the factory's operating system. The scheduler deciding what runs next, models predicting cycle time and demand, systems interpreting engineering drawings, analytics tracking production, and operators understanding what is happening on the floor all depend on the same thing: a trustworthy path from the physical and software systems that generate data to the teams and products that use it.

The Data Platform team owns that path. We build the shared infrastructure for ingestion and CDC, event streaming, the warehouse and lakehouse, orchestration, data contracts, quality, lineage, and the foundational data models that sit underneath Analytics, Data Science, Operations Research, ML, and operational software. Today that includes Snowflake, Iceberg on S3, PeerDB, Redpanda/Kafka, Dagster, dbt, Kubernetes, and protobuf/gRPC. Some of our data begins in conventional software systems. Some begins on CNC machines, inspection equipment, PLCs, engineering files, and the factory floor.

As an Senior Engineering Manager, you will build and lead the team responsible for making this platform reliable, coherent, and useful as Hadrian scales to many factories. You will own the people, execution, operating quality, and direction of the team while staying technically close enough to challenge architecture, understand failure modes, and help engineers make good tradeoffs.

What You’ll Do

Build the team and platform that become Hadrian's data backbone. Lead the engineers responsible for the path from machines and operational systems to the trusted datasets, streams, and interfaces that scheduling, analytics, ML, software, and factory operations depend on.
Own the Data Platform roadmap and delivery. Turn ambiguous needs across Software, Infrastructure, Analytics, Data Science, Operations Research, ML, and Manufacturing into clear priorities, interfaces, owners, and commitments.
Raise the operational bar for the platform: reliability, data-quality SLAs, observability, incident response, backfills and recovery, cost, security, schema evolution, provenance, and clear ownership when something fails.
Partner with senior engineers and technical leads on architecture across CDC and streaming, Snowflake and Iceberg, orchestration, data contracts, schema governance, and the interfaces between the data platform and its consumers. You do not need to design every system yourself, but you need the depth to ask the hard questions and recognize when important semantics or failure modes are missing.
Turn repeated one-off work into paved roads. Build standards, contracts, tooling, documentation, and migration paths that let other engineering and data teams move faster without creating a collection of bespoke pipelines.
Hire and grow an exceptional team. Set a clear technical and performance bar, give direct feedback, develop engineers into broader technical leaders, delegate real ownership, and build a team whose capability grows faster than its headcount.

What We’re Looking For

A track record leading engineers responsible for production data infrastructure, distributed systems, developer platforms, infrastructure, or similarly critical technical systems. For Senior EM, you have led multiple substantial workstreams or teams and developed senior technical leaders.
Strong technical judgment in modern data and platform systems: event streaming and CDC, warehouses and lakehouses, orchestration, schema evolution, data modeling, distributed-system failure modes, and the tradeoffs behind reliable data delivery.
Experience building for environments with real constraints. You understand that the architecture changes when data comes from hardware, machines, devices, files, telemetry, regulated systems, edge environments, or other sources that do not behave like a clean application database.
A real platform mindset. You think in shared abstractions, contracts, ownership, operating guarantees, adoption, migration, deprecation, and paved roads — not just a set of infrastructure components owned by one team.
An operator's mindset. You know what your systems promise, how you know they are healthy, what happens when those promises fail, and how an incident becomes a permanent improvement rather than a recurring story.
Strong people leadership and high agency across organizational boundaries. Your engineers know what is expected of them, where they stand, and how they can grow; when a dependency is blocking the team, you go resolve it rather than simply reporting it upward.

What Will Set You Apart

5+ years of management experience in manufacturing, semiconductors, hardware, robotics, autonomy, industrial systems, test/measurement, or edge computing, especially where the data platform had to bridge software with physical systems. Backgrounds from companies such as NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Xilinx, Altera, Qualcomm, Applied Materials, Lam Research, Tesla, Anduril, Shield AI, or similar environments are especially relevant.
Experience with heterogeneous data beyond application tables: telemetry, events, files, device identity, timestamps and clock drift, units, provenance, schema drift, deletes, late or out-of-order data, partial records, retries, and backfills.
Experience taking a data or infrastructure platform from an early working system to a broadly adopted internal product used by many teams.
Experience operating in security-sensitive or regulated environments such as aerospace, defense, FedRAMP, CMMC, or other environments where data governance and access control are part of the architecture.
A track record of building strong hiring and onboarding systems and helping senior engineers become effective technical leads, Staff+ engineers, or future managers.

Compensation

For this role, the target salary range is $249,000 -
$299,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Benefits For Full-time Employees

Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees
401k
Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.
Flexible vacation policy
Equity

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Use of AI in hiring

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy.
